hero.title: Coffee worth slowing down for.
hero.text: We roast small batches every Tuesday and pour them a few metres from the roaster. Twelve seats, three coffees on bar, no rush.

ticker: Oat milk at no extra cost
Pastries from the bakery next door

beans.title: Three coffees, roasted a few metres away
beans.text: We keep the list short so every coffee gets dialled in properly. Each one is roasted for how we brew it, not the other way round.

steps.title: Source
steps.text: Green coffee from three regions, bought by the harvest season.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Every Tuesday morning on a 5 kg drum roaster, in batches of twelve.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Seven to ten days of degassing before a bean reaches the grinder.

steps.title: Brew
steps.text: Dialled in each morning: dose, yield and time, tasted before we open.

menu.title: Pick a drink and watch it pour
menu.note: Oat, almond and whole milk at no extra cost. Decaf on request.
